description: This file defines the TelemetryImplementation class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It declares interfaces, nested classes, and methods related to telemetry reporting, power management notifications, and user settings notifications. The class manages event registration, report handling, and power mode changes, serving as a core component for telemetry functionalities in the plugin.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry and configuration interfaces, managing notifications, reports, and power events.

nested_classes.name: PowerManagerNotification
nested_classes.description: Notification class for power mode changes, implementing IPowerManager::IModeChangedNotification.

nested_classes.name: UserSettingsNotification
nested_classes.description: Notification class for user privacy mode changes, implementing IUserSettings::INotification.

nested_classes.name: Job
nested_classes.description: Represents a telemetry job dispatched asynchronously, handling report events.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the TelemetryImplementation instance.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with name and value.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided service.
